findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** divide the First Main Theorem by $T$ and use that $T\to\infty$, then bound nonnegative numerators by $T$.
findings.symptom: The CSS-uppercase technique banner exposes the raw $ delimiters and TeX command in the math-bearing phrase.
findings.suggested_repair: Render math in the technique banner without exposing delimiters/commands.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** direct, using radial convergence, the $H^1$ Cauchy representation, and a local closed-range argument.
findings.symptom: The CSS-uppercase technique banner shows literal $H^1$ delimiters instead of rendered math.
findings.suggested_repair: Render math in the technique banner without exposing delimiters.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** prove removability of the unit circle by gluing analytic $1$-quasiconformality across it, then use Möbius invariance and subset monotonicity.
findings.symptom: The CSS-uppercase technique banner shows literal $1$ delimiters around a mathematical quantity.
findings.suggested_repair: Render math in the technique banner without exposing delimiters.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** split the failure set according to the integer level of $u$; the first crossing radii $s_m$ of the levels $m$ give an explicit cover of the failure set by intervals of lengths $m^{-1-\varepsilon}$, whose total length is a convergent series.
findings.symptom: The CSS-uppercase technique banner exposes raw $ delimiters for u and epsilon.
findings.suggested_repair: Render math in the technique banner without exposing delimiters/commands.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** normalise the five values to finite values by a Möbius map, compare the common value counts with the zeros of $F-G$, apply the truncated Second Main Theorem to both normalised functions, and use the characteristic growth to reach a contradiction unless $F-G\equiv0$.
findings.symptom: The CSS-uppercase technique banner exposes raw $ delimiters and the TeX command \equiv.
findings.suggested_repair: Render math in the technique banner without exposing delimiters/commands.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: “f(z) ne 0 on gamma*”; step 1.1 says f composed with gamma is a closed contour whose trace misses 0; step 3.1 identifies integral_gamma f'/f dz with 2 pi i n(f composed with gamma,0).
diagram_candidates.reason: The theorem explicitly equates a domain contour integral with the winding of its image cycle; a two-panel map makes the image and index relation concrete.
diagram_candidates.maps_relations_content_to_draw_or_check: Draw gamma in the z-plane and f∘gamma in the w-plane with 0 marked outside the image trace; show traversal direction, source-to-image mapping, and the signed winding index. Check orientation and that the image avoids 0.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: P={a+s omega_1+t omega_2:0<=s,t<=1}, boundary avoids zeros/poles; zeros and poles in P° have equal multiplicity count; residues in P° sum to zero.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: oriented fundamental parallelogram with paired edges and divisor marks
diagram_candidates.reason: The claims rely on cancellation of opposite sides by lattice periodicity and interior zero/pole multiplicities, which benefit from an explicit fundamental-cell view.
diagram_candidates.maps_relations_content_to_draw_or_check: Draw positively oriented P with edge vectors omega_1 and omega_2, identify opposite edges by translations, and mark interior zero/pole locations with multiplicity and residue labels; indicate no boundary zeros or poles. Check orientation, edge pairing, and which marks contribute to each sum.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: Normalized cycles satisfy P(a_i,omega_j)=delta_ij; Pi_ij=P(b_i,omega_j); the period lattice is generated by e(a_i),e(b_i) and in normalized coordinates is Z^g+Pi Z^g.
diagram_candidates.diagram_kind: symplectic homology cycles and period-coordinate map
diagram_candidates.reason: The result links a_i,b_i cycles to normalized differential periods, a matrix, and the resulting lattice; a schematic cycle-to-period map can expose indexing and sign conventions.
diagram_candidates.maps_relations_content_to_draw_or_check: On an oriented genus-g surface, show the a_i,b_i cycle pairs with their intersection convention, arrows to the normalized a-period matrix I and b-period matrix Pi, then the lattice vectors e(a_i),e(b_i) in Omega(X)*. Check cycle orientation, indices, and the sign in the intersection pairing.

diagram_candidates.exact_source_claim: S=C\{x in R:x<=0}; V_n={r e^{i theta}:r>0,-pi/n<theta<pi/n}; R_n(z)=exp(Log z/n); R_n maps S biholomorphically onto V_n with inverse w maps to w^n.
diagram_candidates.reason: The statement gives an explicit branch map and inverse between two planar regions; a domain/codomain sketch can clarify the branch cut and argument range.
diagram_candidates.maps_relations_content_to_draw_or_check: Draw the nonpositive real-axis slit, the open sector with rays at angles ±pi/n, and arrows z↦R_n(z), w↦w^n; mark excluded boundary rays, argument ranges, and verify the composed maps and orientation.

review_summary.notes: The frozen item snapshot hash matches the assigned source hash for every item; local source and preview HTML hashes match assignment values. PNG hashes match screenshot manifests. CSS uppercase technique banners are expected; only the five banners with visible raw math delimiters/commands are reported. Internal wikilinks are intentionally block-line and were not flagged for their split presentation.

limitations: Review used local frozen snapshots, local preview HTML and local PNG tiles only.
No live website or HTTP(S) requests were used.
Every tile was opened as a standalone original-resolution image; no downscaled or collage view was used.
No screenshot finding alleges vertical tile-boundary clipping; the two title clipping findings are visible in standalone original PNGs.
